ideas.title: The cart drives itself on a long cord
ideas.goal: The player bolts the drum motor onto the cart's own frame, belts it to the rear axle and switches on: the cart drives off along the planks under its own power, trailing the cord back to the six pots on the block, until the cord runs out and either yanks the cart to a stop or drags the pots off the table. Where the player puts the pots and how much cord they give is the choice.
ideas.toward: The big goal's cart step itself: motor and switch on the frame, it drives because the parts do. The first time the cart moves on electricity at all; the battery on board comes later and replaces the cord.
ideas.idea: The cart is one rigid body (frame + 4 oak wheels) on whatever is under each wheel (planks as hard ground, sand by the existing WheelSand model). The motor's torque (Motor.step!, real pots, real back EMF) goes through a leather belt (slip when the torque beats belt friction, capstan e^(mu theta)) to the rear axle; the wheels push through contact friction, so in loose sand they spin and dig. The cord is the rope solver's tether (mass per metre, drag on the ground); when it goes taut its tension pulls back on the cart and forward on the pots, each a body with its own mass and friction on the oak block. Watching: the cart rolling away from the block with the motor humming on it, the cord uncoiling behind, then the yank and the pots sliding.
ideas.form: Plugin: the cart with the motor mounted, a key to switch it on in Jump in; events :cart_drove, :cord_yanked; a path traced film from beside the planks.

ideas.title: Will it make the top: the stall is the game
ideas.goal: The player hooks the winch's rope anywhere on the empty cart standing anywhere on the planks or the sand and picks the gear; where it stops is the motor's honest answer, and once stalled the coils heat by I^2 R: switch off in time or the varnish smokes and the motor is weaker for good.
ideas.toward: The winch step (#780) and the dune: it finds out with the real motor, gear and drum how much hill the island's pots can climb, before the cart carries its own battery.
ideas.idea: Not one ramp: the cart is a rigid body on the terrain heightfield with a contact per wheel, the rope a 3D tether hooked at a point on the frame, so a sideways pull turns the cart and a steep spot stops it. The drum's radius grows with the wound rope (Rope.wound_radius), so the pull falls as it climbs and the stall point is where weight x slope + rolling resistance meets torque x ratio / r. The coil's temperature is a heat balance (I^2 R in, convection out, copper's heat capacity), its resistance rises with temperature, the varnish chars above ~150 C and the motor loses turns of insulation (lower k). Watching: the cart inching up, slowing, stopping, the rope trembling taut, the coils starting to smoke if nobody switches off.
ideas.form: Plugin step in irondrum.jl with a cart body and a hook key; smoke particles from the coil above the char temperature; a path traced film of one climb that stalls.

ideas.title: Let it roll back: the motor brakes the cart and charges the pots
ideas.goal: At the top the player lifts the pawl off the big wheel: the cart rolls back down the planks pulling the rope off the drum, the drum spins the motor backwards faster than it ever ran, the motor brakes the cart and pushes current back into the pots; short the terminals and it brakes hard, leave them open and the cart runs away.
ideas.toward: Road: braking that charges the plates; the motor as a generator, found out on the winch with the parts that exist.
ideas.idea: Motor.step! already has back EMF k*omega; driven by the falling cart through the gear, the EMF exceeds the pots' and the current reverses: braking torque k*I, electrical power into the cells. The Daniell pots are reversible: charging dissolves copper from the plate and plates the iron/zinc back, so their blue deepens a little (mass balance per coulomb). A pawl on the big wheel holds the cart (a contact on the cogs) until lifted. Watching: the cart rolling back slow and steady with the drum whirring backwards and sparking, or, open circuit, rattling off the end of the planks.
ideas.form: A pawl part on the countershaft, a key to lift it and a switch with three positions (pots, short, open) in Jump in; events :pawl_lifted, :regen_braking.
